rich_narrative.summary: Emgage Foundation mobilizes Muslim American voters through civic education, leadership development, and non-partisan voter engagement programs [3]. <cite id="3">Founded in 2017</cite>, the organization aims to empower communities and forge pathways to social change [3]. In FY2024, the foundation managed <cite id="3">Total Revenue of $4,069,674</cite>, which reflects a 17% decline from its FY2023 revenue of $4,918,661 [3]. <cite id="2">Charity Navigator awards Emgage Foundation an overall rating of 97/100</cite>, citing high performance in accountability and leadership [2]. Operating with <cite id="3">a 93.5% program expense ratio in FY2024</cite>, the vast majority of its financial resources directly support community engagement, civic training, and domestic outreach initiatives [3]. <cite id="3">The organization also made $770,000 in domestic grants to community partners</cite> in FY2023 to expand its grassroots reach [3].
